source: Attention all security and medical|personnel, be advised that Patient|William Redmoor is code yellow.
This is an emergency broadcast message|for Pelf and the surrounding areas|and, er, doesn't look like this is a test.
The mayor has declared a state of|emergency and ordered all local law|enforcement and emergency personnel
For further information, please switch|to Channel Two for emergency traffic|and tune your receiver to (garbled).
|Get down on the ground,|down on the ground.
|Do you even have the slightest idea|where you're going, William?
|You're like a mouse trapped in|a maze, looking for its cheese.
|But guess what, William?|The cheese is all gone.
|You can't hide from me, William...|this building is like a part of me now.
|I saw so much potential.|I thought we'd make the perfect team.
||I'm not going to hurt you, William.
|I'm just going to rip your soul|from your body and devour it.
|You may feel a brief moment|of discomfort.
|You think you're in control,|William, but you're not.
|You and I have a special|relationship, William.
After all, how many can say|they've actually touched|your brain?
|but everything you do just|brings me closer to my goal.
|And, as you should've learned|by now, it's always a test.
|We're like two sides of|the same coin, William.
|Neither of us can succeed|without destroying the other.
|Do you know what my biggest|mistake was, William?
|Not cutting off your head|when I had the chance.
|Soon, the Plane of Anguish will|burst through to our world.
The sun will blacken, blood|will fall like rain, and the air|will be filled with the music of pain.
|You wouldn't want to miss that,|would you?
|What did this world ever do|for you to deserve such sacrifice?
It stole your wife and daughter,|took your sanity, and left you|here in this black pit of humanity.
Can you feel it, William?|Pressing down on you like|the weight of the world?
|All security and medical personnel,|report to infirmary C, STAT.

Upper Peninsula Intelligencer - August 8, 1968
PELF--A state-run psychiatric hospital has been shut
down just weeks after a Detroit news station exposed
shocking living conditions for many of its patients.
Undercover reporter Carlos Frewer worked as an
orderly at the hospital for three months, all the while
secretly filming incidents of neglect and abuse at the
hands of other staff members. Many of the allegations of
cruelty center on the failure to update the building,
formerly a state prison, to provide adequate care.

Upper Peninsula Intelligencer - April 2, 1940

PELF - The U.S. Coast Guard has installed an
automatic beacon control system at Pelf
Point Light, just two weeks after the lighthouse
caretaker disappeared without trace. The
caretaker, Owen Rice, had been on the job
less than a month prior to his disappearance.
Authorities have stressed that Rice was not a
local, and may have simply abandoned his post.

NOTICE

Investigation of Inmate Complaint #7332 has
concluded. Investigator finds no evidence to
support allegation that chicken prepared in
kitchen facility is unfit for human consumption.
A link to the recent salmonella outbreak and
subsequent illnesses in Cell Block B cannot be
established. No further action is required.

- ALL KITCHEN STAFF -

In order to reduce spoilage, check all vats
for rodents and/or droppings BEFORE adding
ingredients. Thank you.
